courses.overview: 從富岳 A64FX、SVE 與 Tofu D延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend fugaku a64fx, sve and tofu d to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: Summit 超級電腦架構
related.why: 皆分析 CPU、記憶體與系統通訊
related.whyEn: Both analyze CPUs, memory and communication
related.transfer: 皆分析 CPU、記憶體與系統通訊
related.transferEn: Both analyze CPUs, memory and communication
related.difference: 富岳以 A64FX CPU 向量為主，Summit 有 V100 GPU
related.differenceEn: Fugaku centers on A64FX vectors; Summit includes V100 GPUs

place.name: Oak Ridge 公開科學運算城市代表點
place.nameEn: Oak Ridge public scientific-computing city reference
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「Summit 超級電腦架構」共用的資料／元件介面；以「皆分析 CPU、記憶體與系統通訊」指出能保留的條件。
針對「富岳以 A64FX CPU 向量為主，Summit 有 V100 GPU」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with summit supercomputer architecture; use "Both analyze CPUs, memory and communication" to identify retained conditions.
For "Fugaku centers on A64FX vectors; Summit includes V100 GPUs", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

courses.summaryEn: Fugaku supercomputer architecture connects interfaces, data and acceptance through fugaku a64fx, sve and tofu d. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.

courses.connectionEn: Connect system goals to architecture comparison, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: 富岳連線 A64FX 向量 CPU、HBM2 和 Tofu D；本課強調不同架構不能只按峰值比較。
history.textEn: Fugaku connects A64FX vector CPUs, HBM2 and Tofu D; different architectures cannot be compared by peaks alone.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
